say:1:1421448001:0.text: The frenzied crowd surges forward like a tidal wave, sweeping up even the patients still waiting for treatment.
say:1:1421448001:0.source_cn: 狂热的人群犹如潮水般涌上前来，甚至连还在等候治疗的病患...
say:1:1421448001:0.male: The frenzied crowd surges forward like a tidal wave, sweeping up even the patients still waiting for treatment.
say:1:1421448001:0.female: The frenzied crowd surges forward like a tidal wave, sweeping up even the patients still waiting for treatment.

say:3:1421448002:1.text: Back! All of you! Contain yourselves!

say:5:1421448003:1.text: Lord Indris! It's thanks to you I've gained my freedom!
say:5:1421448003:1.source_cn: 是因度厄大人！多亏了您，我才能获得自由！

say:6:1421448004:1.text: You're welcome. How are you feeling—

say:7:1421448005:1.text: So! Do you need attendants now? I hear you're without companions! May I apply?
say:7:1421448005:1.source_cn: 所以，您需要侍奉的人吗？我听说了，您现在身边没有别人！

say:10:1421448007:2.text: Move aside! Lord Ravion! Remember me?
say:10:1421448007:2.source_cn: 让开，让开！沙利叶大人，是我呀，沙利叶大人！

say:11:1421448008:1.text: My jewelry business survived thanks to your protection!
say:11:1421448008:1.source_cn: 沙利叶大人，以前多亏了您的庇护，我的珠宝生意才能维持！

say:12:1421448009:1.text: But those damned new guards, those lowborn wretches, confiscated everything—
say:12:1421448009:1.source_cn: 但那些该死的新卫队，那些泥腿子，他们居然没收了我的财产——

say:13:1421448010:1.text:
We don't confiscate without due cause—
Hey, stop pushing!
say:13:1421448010:1.source_cn: 我们不会无缘无故地没收正当的财——\n喂，别推了！

say:14:1421448011:1.text: Lord Indris! Need coin? I'll collect levies for you!
say:14:1421448011:1.source_cn: 看我这边，因度厄大人！您需要财产吗？我可以帮您去征收！

say:15:1421448012:1.text: The Magister's grace cured my corruption! I feel like I've been reborn!
say:15:1421448012:1.source_cn: 我的孽化多亏了魔法师的恩赐，已经好了，现在我充满力量！
say:15:1421448012:1.male: The Magister's grace cured my corruption! I feel like I've been reborn!
say:15:1421448012:1.female: The Magister's grace cured my corruption! I feel like I've been reborn!

say:16:1421448013:1.text: Lord Ravion! Take me into your service! My loyalty is absolute!
say:16:1421448013:1.source_cn: 沙利叶大人！您看看我这边！我可以为您效力！我愿意侍奉您——

choice_prompt:17:1421448013.text: Lord Ravion! Take me into your service! My loyalty is absolute!
choice_prompt:17:1421448013.source_cn: 沙利叶大人！您看看我这边！我可以为您效力！我愿意侍奉您——

say:18:1421448014:1.text: The jostling crowd barely pays attention to Indris' raised voice...
say:18:1421448014:1.source_cn: 人群推推挤挤，因度厄不得不提高了声音维持秩序，但收效甚微。
say:18:1421448014:1.male: The jostling crowd barely pays attention to Indris' raised voice...
say:18:1421448014:1.female: The jostling crowd barely pays attention to Indris' raised voice...

say:21:1421448015:3.text: Until Ravion draws his sword. Then, silence falls.
say:21:1421448015:3.source_cn: 直到沙利叶拔出了剑，周围才安静了片刻。
say:21:1421448015:3.male: Until Ravion draws his sword. Then, silence falls.
say:21:1421448015:3.female: Until Ravion draws his sword. Then, silence falls.

say:23:1421448016:0.text: Listen closely, darlings. Your new leader and the Magister will now bless your streets with their presence.
say:23:1421448016:0.source_cn: 好了，各位，让到一边去，为我们新的领导者和伟大的魔法师...
say:23:1421448016:0.male: Listen closely, darlings. Your new leader and the Magister will now bless your streets with their presence.
say:23:1421448016:0.female: Listen closely, darlings. Your new leader and the Magister will now bless your streets with their presence.

say:24:1421448017:1.text: Should anyone so much as sigh without permission—
say:24:1421448017:1.source_cn: 谁要是不小心，再让气流从喉咙里吐出来，发出半点声音——

say:25:1421448018:1.text: My blade will ensure it's your last breath. Understood?
say:25:1421448018:1.source_cn: 我的剑就会帮忙堵住。听懂了吗？

say:26:1421448019:3.text: The crowd that ignored Indris' commands now parts with trembling reverence at Ravion's threat.
say:26:1421448019:3.source_cn: 面对因度厄的劝阻反而得寸进尺的人群，在这冷淡的威胁面前...
say:26:1421448019:3.male: The crowd that ignored Indris' commands now parts with trembling reverence at Ravion's threat.
say:26:1421448019:3.female: The crowd that ignored Indris' commands now parts with trembling reverence at Ravion's threat.

say:27:1421448020:0.text: Taking advantage of this brief pause, you finally manage to slip away from the still-crazed crowd.
say:27:1421448020:0.source_cn: 趁着这短暂的空当，我们才得以从依旧狂热的人潮中脱身。
say:27:1421448020:0.male: Taking advantage of this brief pause, you finally manage to slip away from the still-crazed crowd.
say:27:1421448020:0.female: Taking advantage of this brief pause, you finally manage to slip away from the still-crazed crowd.

choice:17:0:1.text: This is getting out of hand...
choice:17:0:1.male: This is getting out of hand...
choice:17:0:1.female: This is getting out of hand...
